text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. Black high-neck double-breasted short coat, gray pleated mini skirt, gray ribbed slouch socks, black knee-high leather boots.。配饰：黑色腋下单肩包。按自然穿搭位置或旁置排列，无人无人台。
original_prompt: Edit this exact complete wardrobe board. Remove the extra black gloves and extra tights on the right. The ONLY separate accessory is the black shoulder bag. Preserve the coat, skirt, gray slouch socks and tall boots. Keep all remaining objects, garment designs, colors, fabrics and positions unchanged. Pure white background, no people, body parts, mannequins or text. Do not add anything.
